caption:
Swipe ↓ A federal judge just ruled you have no constitutional right to clean water or honest answers from the government 💧

The belief most people held, the actual ruling, the Bloomberg BREAKING post reaching 2.7 million views, the twist stripping both protections at once, the fallout for anyone trying to sue their city on constitutional grounds, and what businesses can do when officials don't owe them the truth

Courts are quietly redefining what constitutional protection actually covers. This ruling means any city that contaminates water and covers it up now faces a far lower constitutional bar. In a world where officials owe you less than you thought, the businesses that build their own information systems stop waiting to be told the truth.

Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what that looks like for yours.

Sources: Bloomberg, unusual_whales on X

#cleanwater #constitutional #publichealth #governmenttransparency #legalrights
